projects.name: Mellingen – Äbereich
projects.tagline: Regenerative farm in the Reuss valley, Canton Aargau
projects.summary: An organic farm in Aargau's Reuss valley, close to floodplains of national importance, developed as a model for regenerative agriculture. NFA measures how ecological condition changes on the farm against independent reference areas.
projects.imageAlt: Aerial view of the Mellingen site: farmland, forest and the Reuss
